visual_action: A passenger plane flies overhead across a blue sky above what appears to be a golf course with a large crowd. People in the foreground point up at the plane. A social media post is overlaid on the video. The clip ends with a black and white sequence of shots of the White House and a helicopter, with 'THE WHITE HOUSE' text overlay.

cast.name: Donald J. Trump
cast.evidence: An on-screen overlay shows a social media post attributed to 'Donald J. Trump' (@realDonaldTrump) stating, 'Flying over Ryder Cup, now! DJT'.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video ends with the text 'THE WHITE HOUSE' over imagery of the building. The TikTok was posted by the @whitehouse account.

on_screen_text.text: Donald J. Trump 💕 ▶️ @realDonaldTrump Flying over Ryder Cup, now! DJT 482 ReTruths 2.52K Likes Sep 26, 2025 at 10:59 AM

spoken_summary: A crowd is heard chanting "USA! USA!" throughout the first part of the clip.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of a crowd chanting loudly and energetically. There is no music. The effect is patriotic and exciting.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single shot of a plane flying overhead, followed by a hard cut to a short, stylized, black-and-white montage of the White House and a helicopter.
central_claim: Donald Trump's appearance over the 2025 Ryder Cup was celebrated by a patriotic crowd, an event now presented under the branding of The White House.
intended_effect: To generate feelings of patriotism and admiration for Donald Trump, and to associate him and his popular support with the institution of the White House.
uncertainty_flags: The authenticity of the social media post overlaid on the video cannot be verified; it might be a fabricated graphic rather than a genuine screenshot.
